title: Main Street Financial Services Corp. Declares Quarterly Dividend
description: WOOSTER, Ohio, July 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Main Street Financial Services Corp.  (OTCQX:MSWV), (the “Company”), the holding company parent of Main Street Bank Corp. (the “Bank) has declared a cash dividend of $0.15 per share of the Company’s common stock for the quarter ending June 30, 2026. The quarterly cash dividend will be paid on August 7, 2026 to stockholders of record as of July 27, 2026.
